1. Company Overview sig9.dev is a U.S.–Brazil distributed software services company that “turns ideas into software and guarantees continuity for existing applications.” The company connects U.S.■based engineering teams with exceptional Brazilian developers, enabling clients to scale quickly while giving Brazilian engineers global career opportunities. 2. Mission & Vision Mission: Create mutual value through remote collaboration—U.S. clients ship faster; Brazilian engineers earn career■defining work. Vision: Better teams. Better software. Exceptional growth. 3. Core Services  Staff Augmentation – end■to■end hiring, payroll and compliance for Brazilian contract engineers

 Software Consulting – proofs of concept, architecture, cloud strategy, continuous delivery  Team Scalability & Agility – expert squads that spin up or down with the roadmap  Cost Predictability & Compliance – transparent rates, U.S. & Brazil legal/tax coverage 4. Engagement Models & Specialties Engagements: staff augmentation, dedicated teams, custom projects. Technical specialties: ASP.NET Core, Node.js, Python, Angular, React, Vue, C#, Azure, Docker, DevOps, cloud networking, databases (SQL & NoSQL). 5. Team & Locations Company size: 2■10 employees (LinkedIn 2025). Headquarters: Portland, OR, USA. Brazil hub: Belo Horizonte, MG. All engineers work remotely across Brazil and the U.S.

6. Partnerships & Programs  NVIDIA Inception member (since 2025) – accelerating internal AI R&D.  OpenWebUI + LiteLLM shared AI workspace deployed on private VPN.  Exploring Microsoft Partner Center, Google for Startups, Amazon partner programs. 7. Internal Products & R&D SamwiseAI – browser■based Linux workspace with real■time conversational AI assistance. Sig9■KB – in■house Retrieval■Augmented Generation knowledge base powered by LiteLLM. Other initiatives: multi■desktop VM manager, automated agent framework demo for prospect ORI. 8. Representative Client Suntek Solutions – U.S. hospitality systems provider with two Brazilian developers staffed by sig9.dev (as of 2025).

9. Social Proof & Thought Leadership LinkedIn highlights (2025):  Time■zone mastery in global remote teams.  OpenWebUI + LiteLLM for shared AI knowledge.  Front■end stack trends (React/Next, Vue/Nuxt, Angular) and edge computing.  Fork■centric Git workflows for cleaner repos.  Legacy system rescues and modernization services. 10. Contact Information Website: https://sig9.dev Email: contact@sig9.dev Phone: +1 (503) 388■6127 “Book a 15■min intro call” link available on homepage. 11. Privacy Policy (Excerpt) This document contains an excerpt; refer to sig9.dev/policy/privacy for full text.

SIG9 LLC (“sig9.dev”) is dedicated to protecting the confidentiality and privacy of information entrusted to it. As part of this obligation, sig9.dev is committed to the appropriate protection and use of personal information collected through its websites, applications and other activities… (updated March■2,■2022).
